This page keeps source citations in one place as more textbooks, manuals, standards, articles, and other technical references are added. Bibliographic metadata is maintained in `references.bib`.

## Textbooks and technical references

::: {#ref-grob2016}
[1] M. E. Schultz, *Grob's Basic Electronics*, 12th ed. New York, NY, USA: McGraw-Hill Education, 2016.
:::

::: {#ref-opencircuits2023}
[2] E. Schlaepfer and W. H. Oskay, *Open Circuits: The Inner Beauty of Electronic Components*. San Francisco, CA, USA: No Starch Press, 2023.
:::

## Citation style

References use stable IEEE-style numbering. A page can cite a whole source as **[1]** or a specific location as **[1, p. 1182]** or **[1, pp. 1182–1190]**.

As additional sources are added, their reference numbers remain stable so existing citations do not need to be rewritten.
